questions.cardText:
[Zoology] Which of the following animals is known for having both male and female reproductive organs, allowing them to self-fertilize or mate with any individual of their species?
A. Lionfish
B. Snails
C. Platypus
Answer: B. Snails are hermaphrodites, meaning they possess both male and female reproductive organs.
questions.de: Wie nennt man Tiere wie Landschnecken, die sowohl männliche als auch weibliche Geschlechtsorgane besitzen und sich mit jedem anderen Individuum ihrer Art paaren können?
questions.en: What is the term for animals such as land snails, which possess both male and female reproductive organs and can mate with any other individual of their species?

timeline.labelEn: Ovid's Metamorphoses tells the myth of Hermaphroditus, after whom hermaphrodites are named
timeline.labelDe: Ovids „Metamorphosen“ erzählen den Mythos von Hermaphroditos, nach dem Zwitter (Hermaphroditen) benannt sind

questions.notes: Card asks which of lionfish/snails/platypus; the open question asks the term its explanation gives. Card overgeneralises: Wikipedia names pulmonate land snails (and slugs) as the best-known simultaneous hermaphrodites; many marine and freshwater snails have separate sexes. Metamorphoses date (completed c. AD 8) is approximate.

questions.cardText:
[Psychology] Aggression can be elicited by stimulating which part of the brain?
A. Amygdala
B. Pons
C. Cerebellum
Answer: A. Amygdala’s role in social interaction is context-dependent. For example, stimulating the amygdala in a male monkey can result in either aggressive attacks or fleeing behaviors, depending on whether it is in the presence of more or less dominant monkeys.
questions.de: Durch die Reizung welcher mandelförmigen Struktur im Schläfenlappen des Gehirns lässt sich Aggression auslösen – bei einem männlichen Affen je nach Rang der umgebenden Affen Angriff oder Flucht?
questions.en: Stimulating which almond-shaped structure in the brain's temporal lobe can elicit aggression – in a male monkey either attack or flight, depending on how dominant the monkeys around it are?

timeline.labelEn: Karl Friedrich Burdach first identifies and names the amygdala
timeline.labelDe: Karl Friedrich Burdach beschreibt und benennt erstmals die Amygdala (Mandelkern)

questions.notes: Wikipedia (Aggression): stimulation of the amygdala augments aggressive behaviour in hamsters; in primates its role depends more on situational context. Burdach date from the Amygdala article. The card's monkey example is not on the fetched page.
